notes: Bootstraps a fresh Laravel 13 project at install time.
Uses the user-supplied generic Laravel web foundation as the structural overlay.
Does not implement business models or library workflows yet.
Includes VDBS design tokens and selected non-font brand assets; local font binaries are imported only from user-provided archives.
Windows Composer and npm runtimes are resolved robustly without relying on broken relative batch shims.
Bootstrap runs Pint in fix mode before enforcing pint --test as a quality gate.
Resume mode applies a targeted FoundationValidator typing patch required by strict PHPStan analysis.
name: BiblioCollect Bootstrap
